r1:
Twenty-eight unregulated rockets punching through the last eight metres at speeds up to 23.4 m/min on ProDivingClub(Поляны) mean your ascent profile reads less like recreational diving and more like an emergency ballast blow ([DAN: Ascent Rates](https://dan.org/alert-diver/article/ascent-rates/)).

- ProDivingClub(Поляны): 23.4 m/min through the final shallow stretch proves you treat the surface like an extraction point rather than a destination.
- North red sea: 16.2 m/min surfacing speed suggests your BCD inflator doubles as an ejector seat.
- Seven sisters, Marker 39: 37.5 m and an NDL of zero tells us you stay down until your computer starts flashing like a Vegas casino.
- ProDivingClub(Поляны): 59.0 L/min air consumption turns every tank into a desperate sprint for the boat ladder.

Fix it: Practice slow 9-metre-per-minute ascents using a reference line, enforce a 50-bar turn pressure, and spend your safety stops actually hovering instead of bobbing up like a lost buoy.
